item.title: Evidence-Driven Deep Research Agent
item.author: rpatel12@umbc.edu (Rajat Patel)
item.description: How I built visibility into the research process itself — an explicit evidence state, step-level reward signals, and a planner that uses those signals deliberately. Without retraining.
